section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measures and instruments used in the study. It details the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item self-report questionnaire assessing favorable opinions toward one's body; the Multidimensional Body-Self Relations Questionnaire (MBSRQ) with subscales for appearance evaluation and body area satisfaction; the Female Sexual Function Index (FSFI) evaluating six domains of sexual function; the Female Sexual Distress Scale (FSDS) assessing sexually related personal distress; and the New Sexual Satisfaction Scale (NSSS) measuring sexual satisfaction. Demographic information including age, education, ethnicity, and BMI (calculated from measured height and weight) was also collected. Table 1 presents descriptive statistics (range, internal consistency, mean, and SD) for all measures.
